# ChatBound contributor notes

- This is a C# Dalamud plugin targeting .NET 10 with Dalamud.NET.Sdk 15.
- Keep filtering local-only and consent-oriented.
- Do not add remote control, stealth, or functionality that changes another player's client.
- Preserve the profile and dictionary model when extending the UI.
- Validate with `dotnet build` when the Dalamud SDK is installed.
